fields.Name: T010 - Data Explorer Paginate Members
fields.Description: Verifies that the People grid pagination control advances to the next page and shows a different page of records.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 50,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "The People entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section",
    "The pagination control has advanced past the first page (page indicator shows page 2 or higher)",

    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
